goal.en: Talk about your strengths and weaknesses with real examples.
goal.zh: 用真實的例子談你的優點和缺點。

background: bright meeting room with a long wooden table, an open notepad and a glass of water, warm pendant lamps overhead, glass wall, late afternoon sunlight

intro.en: The interview continues. Ms. Wong turns to a fresh page in her notepad.
intro.zh: 面試繼續進行。王經理把筆記本翻到新的一頁。

intro.en: You know what's coming: the two questions every job seeker fears.
intro.zh: 你知道接下來是什麼：每個求職者都害怕的兩個問題。

lines.en: What would you say is your greatest strength?
lines.zh: 你覺得你最大的優點是什麼？

choices.en: Hmm, I don't really have any strengths. I'm a very ordinary person.
choices.zh: 嗯，我其實沒什麼優點，我是個很普通的人。

lines.en: None at all? Then help me out here: why should I hire you?
lines.zh: 完全沒有？那你幫幫我：我為什麼要錄取你？

story.en: In Taiwan, this sounds humble. Here, Ms. Wong simply believes you and writes 'no strengths' on her notepad.
story.zh: 在台灣這聽起來很謙虛。在這裡，王經理直接相信了你，在筆記本上寫下「無優點」。

fail.why: 面試時說自己沒優點，對方會照字面接受。大方說出一個優點並舉例：One of my strengths is that I stay calm with difficult customers.。

choices.en: My biggest advantage is that I'm a very serious person.
choices.zh: 我最大的優點是我是個很認真的人。

lines.en: Serious? As in... you never laugh? Our team jokes around quite a lot.
lines.zh: 嚴肅？意思是……你從來不笑？我們團隊很愛開玩笑耶。

story.en: Ms. Wong tells a small joke to test you. You keep a straight face, just to stay 'serious.' It does not go well.
story.zh: 王經理講了個小笑話測試你。為了保持「認真」，你硬是忍住不笑。結果很不妙。

fail.why: 「認真」直譯成 serious，英文聽起來是「嚴肅、不愛笑」。要說 I'm hardworking. 或 I take my work seriously.；談優點用 strength，不用 advantage。

choices.en: One of my strengths is that I stay calm with difficult customers.
choices.zh: 我的優點之一是面對難搞的客人時能保持冷靜。
choices.tip: One of my strengths is that + 完整句子，說出一個和工作相關的優點。

lines.en: Calm with difficult customers. Can you give me an example?
lines.zh: 面對難搞的客人能保持冷靜。可以舉個例子嗎？

choices.en: Sure. Customers are often stupid, but I never show it.
choices.zh: 當然。客人常常很笨，但我從不表現出來。

lines.en: Our clients are not stupid, Kai. They're the reason we're all here.
lines.zh: 凱，我們的客戶不笨。我們會在這裡，都是因為他們。

story.en: Ms. Wong imagines you meeting her biggest hotel client. She does not like what she imagines.
story.zh: 王經理想像你去見她最大的飯店客戶。她不喜歡自己想像到的畫面。

fail.why: 說客人「很笨」，就算後面說「但我不表現出來」，也會讓人懷疑你的服務態度。舉例時只說事實和你的行動：A customer was upset, so I listened and fixed it.。

choices.en: Once, a customer yelled about a late order. I listened and fixed it.
choices.zh: 有一次，一位客人因為餐點太慢大吼。我先聽他說，然後把問題解決了。
choices.tip: 舉例時用過去式說出狀況和你的行動，比形容詞更有說服力。

choices.en: Yes. One time, a customer is very angry, and I am say sorry to him many times.
choices.zh: 有。有一次，一位客人很生氣，我一直跟他說對不起。

lines.en: Is angry? Wait, is this happening now, or in the past?
lines.zh: Is angry？等等，這是現在發生的，還是過去的事？

story.en: Ms. Wong looks around the room, half expecting an angry customer to walk in. Your great example gets lost in the tenses.
story.zh: 王經理環顧會議室，好像以為會有個生氣的客人走進來。你的好例子就這樣迷失在時態裡。

fail.why: 說過去的經驗要用過去式：a customer was angry、I said sorry。am 後面也不能接原形動詞。整句可以說 A customer was upset, so I apologized and fixed it.。

lines.en: Nice. And what about a weakness?

choices.en: My biggest weakness is that I work too hard and care too much.
choices.zh: 我最大的缺點是工作太認真、太在乎了。

lines.en: Ha, I hear that one every day. Could you give me a real one?
lines.zh: 哈，這個我每天都聽到。可以說一個真正的缺點嗎？

story.en: Ms. Wong adds a tally mark to a list titled 'work too hard.' You are number fourteen this month.
story.zh: 王經理在一張叫「工作太認真」的清單上又畫了一筆。你是這個月第十四位。

fail.why: 「工作太認真」是面試官聽到不想再聽的假缺點，顯得不真誠。說一個真實但不致命的缺點，加上你正在怎麼改進：I'm working on public speaking, so I joined a speech club.。

choices.en: My weakness? Probably spicy food. I can't eat it at all.
choices.zh: 我的弱點？大概是辣的食物吧，我完全不能吃辣。

lines.en: Ha! Good to know for team lunches. But I meant a weakness at work.
lines.zh: 哈！團隊午餐時會記得。不過我指的是工作上的缺點。

story.en: Ms. Wong writes 'no spicy food' in her notes. It's the most useful thing she learns about you all afternoon.
story.zh: 王經理在筆記寫下「不吃辣」。這是她整個下午對你最有用的了解。

fail.why: 面試問 weakness 是指工作上的缺點，不是個人喜好。說一個真實缺點，再用 I'm working on... 說明你怎麼改進。

choices.en: I'm working on public speaking, so I joined a speech club.
choices.zh: 我正在加強公開演講的能力，所以參加了演講社。
choices.tip: 談缺點用 I'm working on...，說出真實缺點和正在採取的行動。

lines.en: A speech club? How is that going?

choices.en: Pretty well. Last week, I gave a five-minute talk without notes.
choices.zh: 還不錯。上週我不看小抄講了五分鐘。
choices.tip: 用具體的進步（五分鐘、不看小抄）證明你真的在改進。

choices.en: It's going so-so. My face is very thin, so it's still hard for me.
choices.zh: 普普通通。我臉皮很薄，所以還是很難。

lines.en: Your face is... thin? You look perfectly healthy to me.
lines.zh: 你的臉……很瘦？你看起來很健康啊。

story.en: Ms. Wong asks if you're eating enough and offers you a cookie. It's a very nice cookie, but you've lost your chance to shine.
story.zh: 王經理問你有沒有好好吃飯，還請你吃了一塊餅乾。餅乾很好吃，但你錯過了表現的機會。

fail.why: 「臉皮薄」直譯成 my face is thin，英文只會聽成臉很瘦。說 I'm a bit shy.，再補上進步的例子：Last week, I gave a five-minute talk.。

choices.en: It's going good. Every week I am improve more and more.
choices.zh: 進行得不錯。我每週都越來越進步。

lines.en: You am improve...? Okay. So it's helping, I think?
lines.zh: 你是 improve……？好喔，所以應該有幫助吧？

story.en: Ms. Wong writes 'speaking: still in progress.' Your grammar just proved your weakness for you.
story.zh: 王經理寫下「口說：仍在進步中」。你的文法剛好幫你證明了自己的缺點。

fail.why: am 後面不能接原形動詞，進行式要用 I'm improving.；「進行得很好」說 It's going well.，不用 good。再舉具體例子更好。

lines.en: Good. Last one: why should we hire you over the other candidates?
lines.zh: 好。最後一題：我們為什麼要錄取你，而不是其他應徵者？

choices.en: Because I'm better than all of them. Trust me, I'm the best.
choices.zh: 因為我比他們都強。相信我，我是最棒的。

lines.en: You haven't even met them, Kai.

story.en: Confidence is good. But Ms. Wong is now quietly hoping the next candidate is a little more humble.
story.zh: 有自信是好事。但王經理現在默默希望下一位應徵者謙虛一點。

fail.why: 自信不等於貶低別人。說出你具體能帶來什麼：I'm good with customers, I speak two languages, and I learn fast.。

choices.en: Because your office is close to my place. I can walk here!
choices.zh: 因為你們公司離我家很近，我可以走路來！

lines.en: That's convenient for you... but what's in it for us?
lines.zh: 這對你很方便……但對我們有什麼好處？

story.en: Ms. Wong now knows you'll never be late. Sadly, that's all she knows.
story.zh: 王經理現在知道你應該不會遲到。可惜的是，她也只知道這件事。

fail.why: Why should we hire you? 是問你能為公司帶來什麼，不是工作對你多方便。列出兩三個和職缺相關的能力就好。

choices.en: I'm good with customers, I speak two languages, and I learn fast.
choices.zh: 我擅長和客人應對，會說兩種語言，而且學得很快。
choices.tip: 回答 Why should we hire you? 時，用三個重點快速總結你的價值。

lines.en: Real examples, not just nice words. That's exactly what I wanted to hear.
lines.zh: 有真實的例子，不只是好聽的話。這正是我想聽到的。

lines.en: For the first time today, Ms. Wong really smiles.
lines.zh: 今天第一次，王經理真心地笑了。

story.en: You showed what you're good at and what you're working on. Ms. Wong now sees a real person, not a list of adjectives.
story.zh: 你說出了自己擅長什麼、正在改進什麼。王經理現在看到的是一個真實的人，而不是一串形容詞。

notes.en: One of my strengths is that...
notes.explain: 大方說出一個和工作有關的優點，後面接完整句子，再立刻補一個真實例子。

example.en: One of my strengths is that I learn new software quickly.
example.zh: 我的優點之一是學新軟體很快。

notes.explain: 談缺點的好句型：說出真實但不致命的缺點，再說明你正在做什麼來改進。

example.en: I'm working on my time management, so I use a planner now.
example.zh: 我正在加強時間管理，所以現在都用行事曆。

notes.en: A customer was upset, so I listened and fixed it.
notes.zh: 有位客人不高興，所以我先聽他說再解決問題。
notes.explain: 舉過去的例子時全部用過去式。不要混用現在式，也不要說 I am say。

example.en: Last month, I trained two new staff members.
example.zh: 上個月，我訓練了兩位新同事。

notes.explain: 「認真」不說 serious（那是嚴肅），說 hardworking；「臉皮薄」不說 my face is thin，說 I'm a bit shy.。

example.en: I'm hardworking, but I'm a bit shy at first.
example.zh: 我很認真，不過一開始會有點害羞。

notes.en: No fake modesty, no fake weaknesses
notes.explain: 在英語面試裡，說「我沒什麼優點」會被當真，「我太認真」則被當成敷衍。誠實說出優缺點，並用例子佐證。

example.en: I'm not a natural speaker, but I've improved a lot this year.
example.zh: 我天生不擅長說話，但今年進步了很多。
